title: Synaptosome Extraction from iPSC-Derived Cortical Neurons
author: Lucas Blasco-Agell
materials: Synaptosomes (SYNs) are then extracted from mature iPSC-derived cortical neurons using Syn-PER‱ Synaptic Protein Extraction Reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

1x of protease inhibitors (Roche) are added to the Syn-PER‱ Reagent immediately before use. 200 μL of Syn-PER‱ Reagent was added to each 6-wp well and cells were lifted from the surface using a cell scraper (Biologix).
SYNs concentration is measured using the Bradford assay solution (Bio-Rad Laboratories)
Resulting SYNs are frozen in 5% (v/v) Dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) at -80 ºC for extended periods, until pHRodoTM Red (ThermoFisher Scientific) conjugation.

steps.title: Centrifuge samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 1200x g for 10 minutes at 4ºC.

steps.title: Isolate and resuspend synaptosomes
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube, centrifuge to pellet the synaptosomes, and resuspend the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the supernatant at 15000x g for 20 minutes at 4ºC.
Resuspend the resulting pellet containing SYNs in Syn-PER Reagent.

steps.title: Quantify protein concentration
steps.instruction: Quantify the protein concentration using optical density in a PowerWave XS multiplate reader (Biotek).
